I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted in that channel yesterday at 09:27 that the West yard Door 2 double-booking was still happening when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. He said he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841. He was talking about the Plains depots on the dealer account, and a January handoff note names that dealer account as Marrow Fieldworks.

I also warned her not to confuse it with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket about a Door 6 tablet freezing. I couldn't find the current support status of #8841 anywhere Pree can see, so I suggested she check with Tobias before the call.
